name: Camping Resort Zugspitze
beschreibung: The Camping Resort Zugspitze is located in **Ehrwald** at the foot of the **Zugspitze** in the Austrian federal state of Tirol. The immediate surroundings are formed by the **Wettersteingruppe** and the **Zugspitzmassiv**. The **Zugspitzbahn** and the lifts of the **Zugspitz Arena** ski area are within walking distance. In summer, **hiking trails** and **via ferratas** are available in the surrounding mountains. The facility has **pitches** for motorhomes and caravans as well as **rental accommodations** in various categories. The **amenities** include a **restaurant**, a **supermarket**, and a **wellness area** with a swimming pool and sauna. Guests can use a **leisure program** with guided activities for adults and a **kids' club**. The campsite is open **year-round** and serves as a **base** for activities in the region.
